deponent_role: Father of Christopher Roy, who died after being found hanging in a segregation cell at Matsqui Institution

events.description: Christopher Roy was diagnosed with ADHD around age nine or ten and later attended a boarding school
events.quote:
he was assessed
as having
Attention-Deficit-Hyperactive
Disorder

events.description: Around age 30, Christopher developed a drug addiction while working in the oil industry and his marriage ended
events.quote:
while working in the oil patch Chris began to abuse
drugs

events.description: The family learned Christopher was in a federal penitentiary in Mission after a break and enter
events.quote:
In the fall of2013
we became aware that Chris was in a federal penitentiary

events.description: Christopher was released on statutory release and parole to a Victoria halfway house and treatment
events.quote: Chris was released from jail on statutory release and parole in March of 20 15

events.description: Christopher relapsed, returned to federal custody at Matsqui Institution and was placed in segregation
events.quote:
By approximately
the beginning
of April of2015,
Chris disappeared

events.description: By the second week of May Christopher stopped all contact with family and friends
events.quote:
by the second week of May
he stopped all contact

events.description: Christopher was found hanging in his segregation cell and removed from the institution unconscious
events.quote:
found hanging by his neck from the ceiling
of his segregation/solitary
confinement
jail cell at Matsqui

events.description: The Matsqui chaplain told the deponent Christopher had been taken to hospital in Abbotsford
events.quote: On or about June 2, 2015, I was informed Chris had been taken to hospital

events.description: Christopher died at Abbotsford Regional Hospital
events.quote:
passed
away at Abbotsford
Regional Hospital on June 3, 2015

events.description: The deponent made FOI requests for documents about his son's death
events.quote:
In August of2015
I made Freedom of Information ("FOI") requests

events.description: First response to the FOI requests, with documents
events.quote:
I received the
first response to such requests, dated November 13, 2015

events.description: Further response to the FOI requests, with documents
events.quote:
I received a further response to my FOI requests,
dated November 18, 2015

events.description: Coroner's inquest; the deponent testified and gave a Will Say, and the jury ruled the death a suicide with recommendations on segregation
events.quote:
At that inquest, the
jury ruled that my son's death was a suicide

events.description: The deponent learned that CSC staff assessing suicide risk were not registered psychologists and that Christopher had been told he would go to Kent Institution hours before self-harm
events.quote: were not registered psychologists at all

referenced_not_attached: Photographs of Christopher Roy's segregation cell (seen by the deponent)
